body.name: \(\Pi_G(\mathcal O_G),\Pi_G^{\mathrm{CA}}(\mathcal O_G)\)
body.construction:
Define the two order projections
\[
 \Pi_G(\mathcal O_G)=
 \left\{\widetilde\pi:
 (\widetilde P,\widetilde B,\widetilde\varepsilon,
 \widetilde\pi)\in\mathfrak F_G(\mathcal O_G)
 \text{ for some }\widetilde P,\widetilde B,
 \widetilde\varepsilon\right\}
\]
and
\[
 \Pi_G^{\mathrm{CA}}(\mathcal O_G)=
 \left\{\widetilde\pi:
 (\widetilde P,\widetilde B,\widetilde\varepsilon,
 \widetilde\Gamma,\widetilde\pi)
 \in\mathfrak F_G^{\mathrm{CA}}(\mathcal O_G)
 \text{ for some }\widetilde P,\widetilde B,
 \widetilde\varepsilon,\widetilde\Gamma\right\}.
\]
The first is the published unrestricted-cross-view order projection; the second is the component-aligned subclass projection.  Neither projection is defined by \(B_\pi\), \(T_\pi\), or a residual-zero test.
